subject.title: fix(ios): sync stale Apple localization catalog

question: Should an iOS-area owner accept this generated catalog synchronization once the current-head generator/check evidence and pending native CI confirm that it is authoritative?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and only an owner can confirm that the checked-in generated Apple catalog is the intended source-of-truth update.

options.title: Validate and merge the generated sync
options.body: Confirm redacted current-head generator/check output and pending native CI, then merge the two-file catalog synchronization.

options.title: Regenerate from an updated source set
options.body: If an iOS owner finds the catalog should be produced from newer source strings or a different generator revision, replace this output with that authoritative regeneration.

recommendation.title: Validate and merge the generated sync
recommendation.body: Confirm redacted current-head generator/check output and pending native CI, then merge the two-file catalog synchronization.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context ties this contributor directly to the exact reproduction and focused generator repair, though broader code-history ownership was not available.
